errors: A 24-hour retention period runs as 25 hours on the emulator, which rejects 24. The AWS export keeps your value.

Burstable instance types (t2, t3, t4g) run as m6i.large or m7g.medium on the emulator, which can't read their CPU credit settings. It also ignores root volume settings, so the emulator run doesn't compare them. The AWS export keeps your instance type and volume.

The emulator stores a VPC security group's default egress rule without ports, so the provider's request to remove it (ports 0-0) doesn't match (aws/aws-emulator#46). The group is created; LocalCloud marks it usable, and applying again finishes the rest.
The emulator serves the cache on a port of its own choosing, so the emulator run ignores port changes instead of replacing the cluster. The AWS export keeps the designed port.

The emulator can't delete Redis replication groups, so destroy removes them from Terraform state instead (restarting the emulator clears them). It also picks the port itself, so the emulator run ignores port changes. The AWS export is unchanged.
